turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to bake something for the office bake sale and I've got three ideas.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me walk you through all the options, then you can tell me what you think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is chocolate chip cookies, easy and quick, and I can make like four dozen in an hour.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another option is a lemon drizzle cake, which looks nice but has to be sliced up on the day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could do brownies with a salted caramel swirl, a bit messier but people always go crazy for them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm finished. What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For a bake sale, the cookies are hard to beat, they're quick, cheap, and easy to sell one at a time. The brownies would probably sell out first, though, so they might be worth the mess. The lemon cake looks pretty, but slicing it on the day adds work.
